notes.title: Official Closure Notice – North America Server
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support. Due to the long-term low activity on our North America server, after careful discussion, our studio has made the difficult decision to officially shut it down.[/p][p]However, our development plans are still moving forward. In the future, we look forward to opening servers in other regions and bringing more updates to the game.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused, and once again thank you for your understanding and support.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Milkcraft Studio[/b][/p]

notes.title: Realm of Mislay officially opened!
notes.content: When you complete the "Song of Ice" and "Song of Fire" achievements in Realm of Chill and Realm of Scorch, you will be able to enter the new world Realm of Mislay through the portal!

notes.title: Update log on February 24, 2021
notes.content:
1. Realm of Scorch has been officially unlocked
2. Realm of Chill has been officially unlocked
3. Optimized some UI interfaces
4. Fixed some bugs

We also gave a gift of 100 cheeses to all players who have signed up so far.

Thank you for your support of Milkcraft!
I will continue to try to make the game better!
